data.one_liner: Cross‑platform native map widget for Android and iOS using Google and Apple Maps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single PlatformMap widget that renders native maps on Android and iOS, supporting camera movement, markers, polylines, polygons, circles, and various map gestures.
use_when: Need a native map on both Android and iOS with a unified API
Require markers, camera control, and custom info windows
Want to avoid web or hybrid map solutions
avoid_when: Using a web or Flutter web map
You need advanced map analytics or offline map tiles
strengths: Unified API for markers, camera, and gestures
Supports custom marker images and info windows
Includes snapshot capability and memory‑leak fixes
weaknesses: Requires Flutter embedded views preview (developer preview)
Limited to Android and iOS only
data.setup_notes: Add API key to AndroidManifest.xml; add io.flutter.embedded_views_preview and location usage description to iOS Info.plist; ensure Google Maps API key and Apple Maps usage description are set.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use if only targeting Android or if you prefer a mature single‑platform solution

alternatives.name: apple_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use if only targeting iOS or if you need Apple‑specific features
